issue.summary: Improvement request raised by Aiden (P0, scheduled as a key iteration right after the China National Day holiday, i.e. from 2026-10-08). Today, when a user is @-mentioned in a muted (DND) group, the only cue is a small green '[@ mentioned]' text in the conversation-list preview. There is no new-message indicator, no unread badge on the conversation, and no count on the top-right / tab / app-icon badge, so users routinely miss messages addressed to them. Original feedback from Ellery Wang: 'When I am @-mentioned in a muted group there is only a green text hint, no new-message indicator or top-right badge, so I often miss group messages. Can we match WeChat, where any @ always produces a new-message indicator + badge?' Scope: (1) an @-mention addressed to me must always produce a new-message indicator + unread badge regardless of the group's mute state (WeChat parity); (2) add a Slack-style 'Mentions / @Me' aggregated list that collects every message that @-mentions me across all conversations in one place.
steps: Mute (DND) a group chat on any client (Web / macOS / Windows / iOS / Android).
Have another member @-mention me in that muted group.
Observe the conversation list, the conversation's unread badge, the Chats tab / top-right badge and the app-icon badge.
Try to find all messages that @-mentioned me across groups — there is no single entry point for this.
issue.expected: (1) Any @-mention addressed to me (direct @me; @All/@Everyone per product rule) always shows a new-message indicator and increments the conversation's unread badge and the global (tab / top-right / app-icon) badge, even when the group is muted — matching WeChat. Muted groups' ordinary (non-@) messages keep the current silent behaviour. (2) A 'Mentions / @Me' list (Slack-style) aggregates every message that @-mentions me, newest first, with sender, group, time, message preview and read/unread state; tapping an item jumps to that message in context.
issue.actual: In a muted group an @-mention only renders a green '[@ mentioned]' text hint in the conversation preview. No new-message indicator, no conversation unread badge, no top-right / tab / app-icon badge count. There is no aggregated view of messages that mention me, so users miss them.
issue.featureArea: Messaging / Notification & Mention routing / Unread badge / Mentions inbox
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Messaging / Notification & Mention routing / Unread badge / Mentions inbox
- Priority: P0 (set by Aiden). Schedule: key iteration right after the National Day holiday (from 2026-10-08). No milestone assigned — please attach one at sprint planning.
- Proposer: Aiden (Teamily userID 6296335850356299). Original feedback: Ellery Wang (Teamily userID 6226891335107934). Source: Teamily Product Team group chat (group 3106444614), 2026-09-29.
- Acceptance criteria AC1 — Muted group + direct @me: conversation shows a new-message indicator and unread badge; global badge (Chats tab / top-right / app icon) increments by the number of unread @me messages; verified on Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android.
- AC2 — Muted group + ordinary (non-@) message: behaviour unchanged (no badge contribution, no push), so #263 (muted messages must not inflate the badge) does not regress.
- AC3 — Muted group + @me: a system / push notification is delivered (mentions break through mute), consistent across Web and App; product to decide and document whether @All/@Everyone also breaks through mute.
- AC4 — Opening the conversation or reading the mentioned message clears the @ badge on every client (multi-device read sync); counts never get stuck.
- AC5 — A 'Mentions / @Me' entry exists on every client (e.g. sidebar / Activity tab on desktop & web, top-level entry on mobile) listing all messages that @-mention me across conversations, newest first, showing sender, conversation, time, preview and unread state, with its own unread count.
- AC6 — Tapping a Mentions item jumps to and highlights the exact message in its conversation (including history that needs loading); read state syncs back to the list.
- AC7 — The list supports mark-as-read / mark-all-read and pagination, and includes mentions from muted groups, @All/@Everyone (clearly distinguished) and, if in scope, CloudDoc mentions (see #1363).
- Duplicate check: indexed all 2,117 issues (titles + bodies) in Teamily-Inc/teamily-ai-all on 2026-09-29 for mention / @me / Mentions list / mute / 免打扰 / 角标 / badge / unread. No existing 'Mentions / @Me' list request. Related but NOT duplicates: #1821 (muted group suppresses @ notifications; closed as completed with comment '设计如此' / by design — this request deliberately changes that design), #263 (iOS muted-group messages inflating the badge; closed — the opposite direction, must not regress, see AC2), #1363 (CloudDoc mention notifications should go to the notification list; open — candidate content for the Mentions list), #1180 (multi-device sync lag / missed @; closed, different root cause).
- Reference patterns: WeChat (@ in a muted group still shows '[有人@我]' + badge), Slack (Activity → Mentions & reactions).

---
issue.environment: - **Platform / OS / Browser**: All clients — Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android (plus push notification channel)
